chunks: From him, from Nuh ibn Shu'ayb, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) the first, who said:
The one to whom the water of the back changes, so it would be beneficial for him, the milk and the honey.

key_terms.مَاءُ الظَّهْرِ: Water of the back (a medical term referring to fluid or pain in the back)

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of milk and honey according to Imam Al-Reza (AS)?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (AS) prescribes a combination of fresh milk and honey to treat 'water of the back' (ma' al-dahr), a condition often interpreted in Shia medical tradition as rheumatism or joint fluid accumulation. This recommendation highlights the integration of prophetic medicine (Tibb al-Nabawi) with clinical observation, emphasizing the therapeutic synergy of these two natural substances for alleviating musculoskeletal ailments.
